name: Netherlands (Prince's Flag, to 1652)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of orange, white and blue.
history: The Prinsenvlag, the orange, white and blue of William of Orange, flown by the Dutch rebels from the 1570s and the first flag of the Dutch Republic. From the middle of the seventeenth century red replaced orange, and the red, white and blue Statenvlag was prescribed in 1652.
